summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a batch upload pipeline PR, then update all project documentation (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, docs/) to reflect the current state of phases 28-37, and plan the next two development phases.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR review threads resolved and committed; documentation branch created with comprehensive updates to DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, and all docs/ files; Phases 38 (service retirement + circular dep cleanup) and 39 (user-configurable vault parameters) added to roadmap.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the observability/error tracking and remote log shipping solution — not Sentry or Datadog.
FUSE layer (crates/fuse/) is intentionally not unit-tested; Desktop E2E suite provides the coverage. Unit mocking of host OS FUSE APIs would be unreliable.
Vault v1 legacy columns were fully removed when staging was reset; the baseline migration 1700000000000-FullSchema.ts does not include them.
Linux FUSE is implemented under the same `fuse` feature flag as macOS (crates/fuse/src/platform/linux.rs), using NFC normalization and case-sensitive lookups — not a deferred item.
TEE environment is Phala Cloud CVM, not AWS Nitro (the Nitro fallback plan was superseded).
IPNS republish interval is 6h, not 3h — CLAUDE.md had a stale value.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are the remaining deprecated web services not yet migrated to SDK.
@cipherbox/crypto has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only for one test (vault-ipns.test.ts) that cross-checks IPNS key derivation; this should have been cleaned up in Phase 19.1.
The database has grown to 14 tables including share_invites and pin_migrations which were missing from DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md.
AES-256-CTR streaming mode is used for both large video AND audio files in the FUSE layer, not video only.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator-level env var, not a user-facing setting — the user-configurable retention period is still a deferred item.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a zero-knowledge privacy product.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw without cleanup, leaking pending entries — fixed with try/catch that deletes the pending map entry on error.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — fixed to accurately describe the concurrency pool behavior.

Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — intentionally not fixed; architectural change (SDK accepting File objects instead of Uint8Array) is out of scope for this PR and tracked as a deferred item.

Only file in @cipherbox/crypto that imports @cipherbox/core — creates a test-only cross-package dependency that should be refactored to hardcoded test vectors or moved to an integration test directory.

workflow: When asked to audit and prune a list, do every item systematically — not just the ones the user explicitly calls out. A shallow pass that only removes flagged items will require multiple correction rounds.
Resolving GraphQL review threads requires the threadId (not commentId); replies use REST with integer in_reply_to comment ID.
Pre-existing integration test failures (live API tests requiring a running backend) should be distinguished from test failures caused by changes before committing.
DEFERRED.md requires active maintenance as items get implemented; it drifts quickly and needs to be cross-referenced against the codebase rather than trusted at face value.

friction: Multiple rounds of DEFERRED.md correction were needed because the initial audit pass was too shallow — implemented items (Faro log shipping, Linux FUSE, CTR streaming, pin:secondaryFailed events, per-file IPNS) were left in the deferred list.
Edit tool reformatted markdown table whitespace, obscuring exact file content and requiring a raw Bash read to get precise line content for subsequent edits.
The RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var was initially misidentified as implementing the user-facing retention setting and had to be restored to deferred after the distinction was clarified.
CLAUDE.md had stale paths (00-Preliminary-R&D/ instead of .planning/milestones/m0/) and a stale IPNS republish interval (3h instead of 6h) that were not caught until a full docs audit.
DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md was missing 6 migrations and 2 tables, requiring careful cross-referencing of migration files against the documented inventory.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts and bin.service.ts, migrate remaining callers to SDK, and remove @cipherbox/crypto devDependency on @cipherbox/core.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period, soft vs hard delete toggle, versioning defaults (max versions, cooldown period).
Lazy file reading in useDropUpload.ts — SDK API change needed to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array to avoid reading all files to memory before the SDK call.
PR #419 (docs branch) pending review and merge.
SDK batch upload is not implemented in the Rust SDK — feature matrix reflects this gap.
